description.en: Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon.
description.zh: 用大白话把上一条消息重新说一遍，不用行话。

blocks.en: Restate your last message. Stop using jargon and speak coherently. State it more simply and concisely, like one human talking to another.
blocks.zh: 把你的上一条消息重新说一遍。别再用行话，说得连贯一点。说得更简单、更简洁，就像一个人在跟另一个人说话。

lessons.quoteZh: 把你的上一条消息重新说一遍。

zh.title: 直接指着要改的那段
zh.does: 它只把刚才那条回复换个说法讲一遍，不去干别的活。
zh.why: 开头就点明对象是「上一条消息」，AI 不用猜要处理哪一段。
zh.try: 想改哪段就指哪段：「把你刚才回复的第二段重新说一遍。」

en.title: Point at the text to redo
en.does: It just says its last reply again in other words and doesn't start new work.
en.why: Naming the target, "your last message", up front means the AI doesn't guess which part you mean.
en.try: Point at what to redo: "Say the second paragraph of your last reply again."

lessons.quote: State it more simply and concisely

zh.title: 拿原文当参照说「更」
zh.does: 新版本一定比原来那条更短、更好懂，而不是换几个词。
zh.why: 有了原来那条做参照，「更简单」就有了能比的标准。
zh.try: 提修改要求时拿原文比：「比刚才那版短一半，意思不变。」

en.title: Use the original as the yardstick
en.does: The new version is shorter and easier than the old one, not just reworded.
en.why: With the last message as the reference, "simpler" has something to measure against.
en.try: Compare against the original: "Half as long as the last version, same meaning."

lessons.quote: like one human talking to another
lessons.quoteZh: 就像一个人在跟另一个人说话

zh.title: 给口吻找一个真实场景
zh.does: 它不再像写报告，而是像同事站在你旁边跟你解释。
zh.why: 一个人人都熟悉的说话场景，比「通俗一点」这种形容词更容易照着做。
zh.try: 要口吻时给一个场景：「像给不懂技术的家人解释那样，讲一遍这个报错。」

en.title: Pick a scene for the voice
en.does: It stops sounding like a report and sounds like a colleague explaining next to you.
en.why: A conversation everyone knows is easier to imitate than an adjective like "plainer".
en.try: Give a scene for tone: "Explain this error the way you'd explain it to a non-technical relative."
